hero.imageAlt: Florencia Segovia skiing in deep powder snow in Japan

about.title: Florencia Segovia
about.credentials: Argentinian Ski Instructor · Lawyer · WFR Certified · Skydiver & Climber
about.bio: Off the snow, I'm a lawyer, skydiver, and climber. They're not separate worlds to me — in all of them, I read risk, stay calm, and help you progress. My method comes from that mix of discipline and passion.
about.imageAlt: Florencia Segovia, ski instructor in Japan

offPiste.title: Off-Piste
offPiste.text: Terrain, snowpack, and weather read before every run. I'll help you pick the line you'll enjoy most — the kind of run you won't forget.

kids.title: Kids
kids.text: When you love what you do, it shows. I teach kids to ski, build confidence, and understand risk — so they grow into safe mountain people from the very start.
kids.alt: Florencia helping a child with ski equipment

safety.title: Days You'll Want to Relive
safety.text: Every outing has a clear plan, built so you can enjoy it without surprises — the kind of day you'll end up telling and retelling.
safety.alt: Ski group in deep powder snow Japan

approach.title: Progress, Unhurried
approach.text: Progress without pressure. We go step by step, until the movement feels like your own.

services.title: Services

private.title: Private Lesson
private.description: Exclusive one-on-one or two-person instruction — a preferential, specialized experience, fully tailored to your level and goals. The most effective way to progress. Want to bring more people? Just ask and we'll build something custom for you.

kids.title: Kids Lesson
kids.description: Fun, safe progression for children of all ages. Skills built through games and gentle challenges.

offPiste.title: Off-Piste & Backcountry
offPiste.description: I plot my own lines through untracked snow and forest, with full risk assessment before every run.

services.priceNote: Prices vary depending on the ski resort, area, and availability. Message me and I'll quote you based on your plan.
